### I-002: e2e-chaos preflight error message can be misleading on misconfigured kubectl
**File**: `Makefile:340-341` — **Fix**: AUTO-FIX — **Confidence**: uncertain

**Problem**: The preflight in the e2e-chaos target collapses two distinct failure modes into the same error message: 'kubectl can't reach the cluster' (bad/missing KUBECONFIG, kind cluster not running) and 'the cluster is reachable but the chaos-mesh namespace doesn't exist'. A developer hitting the first case is told to run `WITH_CHAOS_MESH=true make deploy-infra`, which itself would fail with a different kind-cluster e

(no code comments)

## Resolution Summary
Both INFO items from the external review were addressed. I-002 was auto-fixed in Makefile:343 by adding a `kubectl version --request-timeout=2s` preflight before the `kubectl get ns chaos-mesh` check, separating the 'cluster unreachable' failure from the 'chaos-mesh namespace missing' failure with distinct, actionable error messages; the recipe header comment was extended to record the rationale and reference the review. I-001 was acknowledged via the PR description / commit log link (commit bfc04619 'chore(CC-0097): link PR https://github.com/C5C3/forge/pull/290') rather than bumping the architecture submodule in this branch — the submodule pointer is intentionally left unchanged. No additional unrelated locations were modified beyond the Makefile preflight reviewer suggestion.
